order by a.occurred_at desc, a.log_id desc limit #{q.page.size} offset #{q.page.offset}

select audit_id as "auditId", occurred_at as "occurredAt", table_nm as "tableNm", row_key as "rowKey", action, actor, before_data::text as "before", after_data::text as "after" from sys_audit_log where audit_id = #{auditId}
select distinct table_nm from sys_audit_log order by table_nm
mapper.sql: f.feedback_id, f.created_at, f.prog_cd, p.prog_nm_key as prog_nm, f.content, f.status, f.client_type, f.user_id, u.login_id, u.user_nm, f.handled_by, f.handled_at, f.row_ver
mapper.select: select from sys_feedback f join sys_user u on u.user_id = f.user_id left join sys_prog p on p.prog_cd = f.prog_cd where f.feedback_id = #{feedbackId}
